name: Reposal
summary: Reposal is a barbiturate derivative invented in the 1960s in Denmark. It has sedative, hypnotic and anticonvulsant properties, and was used primarily for the treatment of insomnia.

pharmacology.text: It has sedative, hypnotic and anticonvulsant properties, and was used primarily for the treatment of insomnia.

uses.text: It has sedative, hypnotic and anticonvulsant properties, and was used primarily for the treatment of insomnia.

sideEffects.en: Little is recorded about it specifically. Barbiturates in general cause drowsiness, dizziness and poor coordination, can lead to dependence with dangerous withdrawal, and can be fatal in overdose.
sideEffects.zh: 關於它本身的紀錄不多。巴比妥類整體而言會引起嗜睡、頭暈和協調變差，可能導致依賴並伴隨危險的戒斷症狀，過量時可能致命。
sideEffects.zhHans: 关于它本身的纪录不多。巴比妥类整体而言会引起嗜睡、头晕和协调制差，可能导致依赖并伴随危险的戒断症状，过量时可能致命。

fact.en: Reposal belongs to the barbiturate family, built on barbituric acid, which the German chemist Adolf von Baeyer first made in 1864.
fact.zh: Reposal 屬於巴比妥類，這類藥物以巴比妥酸為基礎，由德國化學家 Adolf von Baeyer 於 1864 年首次合成。
fact.zhHans: Reposal 属于巴比妥类，这类药物以巴比妥酸为基础，由德国化学家 Adolf von Baeyer 于 1864 年首次合成。
